reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text: I really like this mask! The sheet fits my face well and has plenty of essence without feeling too heavy. My skin feels hydrated and refreshed after using it, and it leaves my skin looking smoother. I’ll definitely use it again.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款面膜！面膜紙貼我面貼得好好，精華液好多，但又唔會太厚重。用完之後皮膚感覺滋潤、清爽，而且睇落更加順滑。我一定會再用！

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text: I think this mask is classic product and when you don’t know what mask you should use, you could just use it without thinking
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款面膜係經典產品，當你唔知應該用邊款面膜嗰陣，就可以唔使諗太多直接用。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text:
Normal facemask, dries fast and has a nice gentle smell. 
It has a cooling effect to calm my skin, dosing see improvements in brightness or imperfections.
reviews.zh:
普通面膜，乾得好快，有好溫和嘅香味。
有清涼效果，令皮膚平靜，但未見到亮度或者瑕疵有改善。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text: The mask and pads are honestly a bit itchy (for someone with sensitive skin). Go for a gel-type texture mask instead if you’re like me! Or try this line but the serum version.
reviews.zh: 面膜同貼片老實講有少少痕癢（對敏感肌膚嚟講）。如果你同我一樣，建議你揀啫喱質地嘅面膜！或者試吓呢個系列嘅精華版本。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text: These sheet masks are incredibly calming and hydrating. Whenever my skin feels irritated or sensitive, they leave it feeling refreshed, soft, and much less red. One of my favorite masks for barrier care.
reviews.zh: 呢啲面膜非常舒緩同保濕。每當我皮膚感到刺激或者敏感，用完之後都會覺得清爽、柔軟，紅感減少好多。係我最愛嘅屏障護理面膜之一。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text:
有名すぎて大バズりしているパックなので、ストック用にまとめ買いしました！
肌の調子が不安定なときはパックをしない方が良いとは分かっていても、どうしても使いたくなるときってありますよね。そんなときでも、このパックなら比較的安心して使えるお守りみたいな存在です！
reviews.zh:
因為太出名、大爆紅嘅面膜，所以我一次過買咗好多作為備用！
明知道皮膚狀態唔穩定嗰陣唔應該做面膜，但係有時真係好想用。即使係咁嘅時候，呢款面膜都係比較安心嘅護身符一樣嘅存在！

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text: The perfect sheet mask for instant barrier relief! I received a generous set of 4 of these masks bundled with my MEDIHEAL serum. The packaging is beautiful, and the formula is highly scientific, featuring 98% pure Madecassoside combined with low-molecular hyaluronic acid. This allows the soothing essence to penetrate deeply into dry, sensitive skin types. The sheet fabric itself is incredibly soft, adheres like a second skin, and holds a massive amount of rich essence. Whenever my skin feels irritated, stressed, or shows redness, I pop one of these on for 15 minutes. It immediately cools down the face, locks in water, and deeply repairs the skin barrier without feeling heavy. A total 10/10 rescue mask!
reviews.zh: 即時修護屏障嘅完美面膜！我收到一套大方嘅四片裝，同 MEDIHEAL 精華一齊套裝。包裝好靚，配方好有科學感，含 98% 純度嘅 Madecassoside（積雪草苷），配合低分子玻尿酸。咁樣可以令舒緩精華深入乾燥、敏感嘅皮膚。面膜紙本身好柔軟，貼服得似第二層皮膚，亦可以盛載大量豐富嘅精華液。每當我皮膚感到刺激、有壓力或者出現泛紅嗰陣，我就會貼一片，敷十五分鐘。佢即刻令面部降溫、鎖住水分，又深層修護皮膚屏障，而且唔會覺得厚重。總分 10/10，係救急面膜！

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Madecassoside essential mask blemish repair 4P
reviews.text: I really liked this mask pack! It feels soothing and hydrating, and my skin looked calmer and less red the next morning. The essence is lightweight and not sticky, and the sheet fits comfortably. I also noticed my blemishes looked less irritated after a few uses. Great for sensitive or stressed skin!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款面膜！用落感覺舒緩又保濕，第二朝我皮膚睇落更平靜、冇咁紅。精華液輕盈唔黏，面膜紙貼得好舒服。我亦留意到，用咗幾次之後，我嘅瑕疵睇落冇咁發炎。好啱敏感或者有壓力嘅皮膚！
